name: batch-07
prompt:
Create ONE production game-icon SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha PNG. Input image is the user's approved style sheet, STYLE reference only. Match that soft tactile dimensional 3D collectible family: gentle warm upper-left diffuse studio light, rounded yet faithful forms, bright pastel/candy color, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained material detail. Each object's true material remains recognizable: paper, wood, glass, metal, woven cloth. No same-clay treatment on everything. No heavy dark outlines or flat vector art.

CRITICAL PACKAGING: There are EXACTLY NINE equal square virtual cells in a regular 3x3 grid. Draw ONE specified object/group centered within EACH virtual cell, at ONLY 48–52% of cell width/height, with at least 24% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON EVERY SIDE. Nothing may touch a virtual cell edge or cross into a neighbor. All strings, handles, leaves and shadows stay inside their own cell. Think SMALL MINIATURE ICONS with LARGE EMPTY GUTTERS, NOT large illustrations filling the sheet. Icon centers are x=16.67%,50%,83.33%, y=16.67%,50%,83.33% of the image. Each icon must fit in a box 18% of the overall image size. Empty space between shapes is essential. No visible grid lines, no backgrounds, no color squares, no borders, no captions, numbers, words, ID labels, titles or decorative props. Empty padding is genuine alpha transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Top-left through bottom-right order is mandatory; do not swap cells. Each tile will be cropped at exact one-third boundaries into a separate icon. Keep centered and similarly weighted, readable at 32–66px. All objects fully in frame, no cropping. Only allow inscription glyphs explicitly specified in subject. Do not invent sacred symbols, cultural ornament, claims or text. No extra humans/hands/landscape/pedestals. Subject list in strict row-major order:
1. Cell row 1, column 1: A shallow grey-beige stone water basin with turquoise water, a pale wooden openwork sieve holding one plain gold-brown coin, and a separate long-handled wooden ladle pouring a thin stream. Keep the coin in the sieve; no denomination or added lettering.
2. Cell row 1, column 2: One small ochre terracotta ball bearing the single character 運 beside a low grey-beige coastal rock with a distinct square recess in its top. Preserve the square target and plain clay surface; no extra coins, ropes or symbols.
3. Cell row 1, column 3: One turquoise cloth carp streamer hanging horizontally to the right from a slim brown pole with a small gold finial. Preserve its open coral-rimmed mouth, cream-and-dark eye, cream scale arcs and split cloth tail; no additional fish or family-color symbols.
4. Cell row 2, column 1: A small square parcel wrapped in sage-green, muted peach and pale ochre patchwork cloth with cream dashed seams. Two broad cream cloth ends form a soft top knot, with short peach tails; preserve folded fabric corners and add no copied motifs.
5. Cell row 2, column 2: A warm honey-brown carved wooden spoon, upright with an open heart-shaped handle and a rounded oval bowl below; preserve the actual hole through the heart and the concave spoon bowl.
6. Cell row 2, column 3: A painted dark-teal clay rooster facing right, with a raised sweeping tail, rust-red comb, ochre beak and legs, a small cream geometric chest mark and a terracotta display base; keep it a ceramic ornament, without invented lettering.
7. Cell row 3, column 1: A thick red dough heart ornament with a small sage hanging loop, a piped ivory heart outline and a pale blue-green oval center edged in gold; retain the decorated dough-and-icing identity, without adding words.
8. Cell row 3, column 2: A warm terracotta-brown painted egg with a pointed upper end and rounded lower end, an ivory diamond around a small sage dot and a curved ivory band near the bottom; keep the original sparse painted design.
9. Cell row 3, column 3: An artificial cream paper-and-wood flower ornament with many narrow pointed radial petals and a round textured tan wooden center; keep it a handmade dry-looking ornament rather than a fresh sunflower or a harvested plant.
